cards.ar: ونوافل النهار إن شاء صلى ركعتين بتسليمة واحدة وإن شاء أربعا وتكره الزيادة على ذلك فأما نافلة الليل فقال أبو حنيفة إن صلى ثمان ركعات بتسليمة واحدة جاز وتكره الزيادة على ذلك وقال أبو يوسف ومحمد: لا يزيد بالليل على ركعتين بتسليمة واحدة
cards.en: In the day, nafl can be two or four rak'ahs with one salam; more than that is makruh. At night, Abu Hanifa allows eight with one salam, and more is makruh. Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad say at night no more than two with one salam.

cards.ask: Idris prays six rak'ahs of nafl in the daytime with one salam. What is the ruling?
options: Makruh: in the day, no more than four with one salam
cards.source: ونوافل النهار إن شاء صلى ركعتين بتسليمة واحدة وإن شاء أربعا وتكره الزيادة على ذلك
cards.why: Daytime nafl is two or four with one salam. Going beyond four is makruh.

cards.title: Where recitation is wajib
cards.ar: والقراءة في الفرض واجبة في الركعتين الأوليين وهو مخير في الأخريين إن شاء قرأ وإن شاء سبح وإن شاء سكت والقراءة واجبة في جميع ركعات النفل
cards.en: Wajib means required (just below fard). In a fard prayer, recitation is wajib in the first two rak'ahs; in the last two he may recite, say "subhan Allah", or stay silent. In nafl, recitation is wajib in every rak'ah.

cards.ask: Is recitation wajib here, or his choice?
items: The first two rak'ahs of a fard
The last two rak'ahs of a four-rak'ah fard
source: والقراءة في الفرض واجبة في الركعتين الأوليين وهو مخير في الأخريين
والقراءة واجبة في جميع ركعات النفل
cards.why: Fard: wajib in the first two only. Nafl: wajib in every rak'ah.

cards.title: Breaking a nafl
cards.ar: ومن دخل في صلاة النفل ثم أفسدها قضاها فإن صلى أربع ركعات وقعد في الأوليين ثم أفسد الأخريين قضى ركعتين
cards.en: Whoever starts a nafl prayer and then breaks it must make it up. If he prayed four, sat after the first two, and then spoiled the last two, he makes up two.

cards.ask: Huda starts a two-rak'ah nafl and breaks it in the middle. Must she make it up?
options: Only if she broke it on purpose
cards.source: ومن دخل في صلاة النفل ثم أفسدها قضاها
cards.why: Once started, a nafl must be made up if it is broken.

cards.title: Sitting, or on a mount
cards.ar: ويصلي النافلة قاعدا مع القدرة على القيام وإن افتتحها قائما ثم قعد جاز عند أبي حنيفة وقال أبو يوسف ومحمد: لا يجوز إلا من عذر ومن كان خارج المصر
cards.en: Nafl may be prayed sitting even if you could stand. If you start it standing and then sit, Abu Hanifa allows it. Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad allow that only with an excuse. Outside the town, you may pray nafl on your riding animal in whatever direction it goes, nodding.

cards.ask: Outside the town, Sulayman wants to pray nafl on his camel, which is heading away from the qibla. May he?
options: Yes, nodding, whichever way it heads
Only if he turns it to the qibla
No: nafl cannot be prayed riding
cards.source: يجوز أن ينتقل على دابته إلى أي جهة توجهت يومئ إيماء
cards.why: Outside the town, nafl on a mount is allowed in any direction, with nods for ruku and sujud.

cards.ask: Which are true of nafl prayers?

options.text: It may be prayed sitting, even if able to stand
Recitation is wajib in every rak'ah
Four rak'ahs before Isha are sunnah
A broken nafl needs no make-up
In the day, eight with one salam is fine

source: ويصلي النافلة قاعدا مع القدرة على القيام
والقراءة واجبة في جميع ركعات النفل
وأربعا قبل العشاء
ثم أفسدها قضاها
وتكره الزيادة على ذلك
cards.why: Sitting is allowed, recitation is wajib in every rak'ah, and four before Isha are sunnah. A broken nafl is made up, and more than four in the day is makruh.

cards.title: The prostration of forgetting
cards.ar: سجود السهو واجب في الزيادة والنقصان بعد السلام ثم يسجد سجدتين ثم يشهد ويسلم
cards.en: Sujud al-sahw is two prostrations made for a mistake by forgetting: adding something or leaving something out. It is wajib (required, just below fard). After the salam, prostrate twice, then say the tashahhud and the salam.

cards.ask: Put sujud al-sahw in order
cards.source: بعد السلام ثم يسجد سجدتين ثم يشهد ويسلم
cards.why: It comes after the salam: two sujud, then tashahhud, then salam.

cards.title: What calls for it
cards.ar: فعلا من جنسها ليس منها أو ترك فعلا مسنونا أو ترك قراءة فاتحة الكتاب أو القنوت أو التشهد أو تكبيرات العيدين
cards.en: It is due when he adds an action of the prayer's own kind that does not belong there, leaves out an action of the sunnah way, leaves out al-Fatiha, the qunut, the tashahhud or the Eid takbirs, or when the imam recites aloud where it should be quiet, or quietly where it should be aloud.

cards.ask: Which of these call for sujud al-sahw?

options.text: He forgot the qunut in witr
The imam recited quietly in Fajr
The follower made a mistake on his own

source: أو ترك قراءة فاتحة الكتاب أو القنوت أو التشهد أو تكبيرات العيدين
أو خافت فيما يجهر
وإن تكلم في صلاته عامدا أو ساهيا بطلت صلاته
وإن سها المؤتم لم يلزم الإمام ولا المؤتم السجود
cards.why: Al-Fatiha, qunut, the Eid takbirs and quiet recitation where it should be loud call for sujud al-sahw. Speaking spoils the prayer, and a follower's own mistake needs no sujud.

cards.title: Imam and follower
cards.ar: فإن لم يسجد الإمام لم يسجد المؤتم وإن سها المؤتم لم يلزم الإمام ولا المؤتم السجود
cards.en: The imam's mistake makes the sujud due on those behind him too; but if the imam does not prostrate, they do not either. If a follower makes a mistake, neither he nor the imam has to prostrate.

cards.ask: Behind the imam, Zakariya forgets something on his own. Who does sujud al-sahw?
cards.source: وإن سها المؤتم لم يلزم الإمام ولا المؤتم السجود
cards.why: A follower's own forgetting needs no sujud from him or the imam.

cards.title: Forgetting the first sitting
cards.ar: ومن سها عن القعدة الأولى ثم تذكر وهو إلى حال القعود أقرب عاد فجلس وتشهد وإن كان إلى حال القيام أقرب لم يعد ويسجد للسهو
cards.en: If he forgets the first sitting and remembers while still nearer to sitting, he goes back, sits and says the tashahhud. If he is nearer to standing, he does not go back, and does sujud al-sahw.

cards.ask: Yusuf forgot to sit for the first tashahhud and is almost fully standing when he remembers. What does he do?
options: Carry on standing, and do sujud al-sahw
Sit back down for the tashahhud
cards.source: وإن كان إلى حال القيام أقرب لم يعد ويسجد للسهو
cards.why: He is nearer to standing, so he does not go back. The sujud al-sahw makes up for it.

cards.title: Standing up for a fifth
cards.ar: ومن سها عن القعدة الأخيرة فقام إلى الخامسة رجع إلى القعدة ما لم يسجد وألغى الخامسة ويسجد للسهو وإن قيد الخامسة بسجدة بطل فرضه وتحولت صلاته نفلا وكان عليه أن يضم إليها ركعة سادسة
cards.en: If he forgets the last sitting and stands for a fifth rak'ah, he goes back to sit as long as he has not prostrated, drops the fifth, and does sujud al-sahw. If he has already made a sujud in the fifth, his fard is lost: the prayer becomes nafl, and he adds a sixth rak'ah.

cards.title: Doubt
cards.ar: ومن شك في صلاته فلم يدر أثلاثا صلى أم أربعا وكان ذلك أول ما عرض له استأنف الصلاة فإن كان الشك يعرض له كثيرا بنى على غالب ظنه إن كان له ظن فإن لم يكن له ظن بنى على اليقين
cards.en: If he doesn't know whether he prayed three or four, and this is the first time it has happened to him, he starts again. If doubts come to him often, he goes with what he thinks most likely; if he has no leaning either way, he goes with what is certain.

cards.ask: Khadija often has doubts. Now she can't tell if she prayed three or four, and has no leaning either way. What does she do?
options: Go with what is certain: three
cards.source: فإن كان الشك يعرض له كثيرا بنى على غالب ظنه إن كان له ظن فإن لم يكن له ظن بنى على اليقين
cards.why: Doubt comes to her often and she has no leaning, so she builds on the certain number, three.

cards.ask: Ahmad sat for the tashahhud after the fourth rak'ah of Zuhr, then stood up thinking it was the first sitting, and prostrated in a fifth. What now?
options: Add a sixth, do sujud al-sahw: his Zuhr is complete and the extra two are nafl
His Zuhr has become nafl and he must pray it again
Go back and sit: the prayer is void
cards.source: وإن قعد في الرابعة قدر التشهد ثم قام ولم يسلم يظنها القعدة الأولى عاد إلى القعود ما لم يسجد في الخامسة ويسلم وإن قيد الخامسة بسجدة ضم إليها ركعة أخرى ويسجد للسهو وقد تمت صلاته والركعتان له نافله
cards.why: He already sat the last sitting, so his fard is done. He joins a sixth to the fifth, does sujud al-sahw, and the two extra rak'ahs are nafl. (Had he not sat, his fard would be lost.)

lessons.title: The sick person's prayer, and sujud al-tilawa

cards.title: When standing is too hard
cards.ar: إذا تعذر على المريض القيام صلى قاعدا يركع ويسجد فإن لم يستطع الركوع والسجود أومأ إيماء برأسه وجعل السجود أخفض من الركوع ولا يرفع إلى وجهه شيئا يسجد عليه
cards.en: If a sick person cannot stand, he prays sitting, bowing and prostrating. If he cannot bow and prostrate, he nods with his head, making the nod for sujud lower than for ruku. He does not lift something up to his face to prostrate on.

cards.title: Lying down
cards.ar: فإن لم يستطع القعود استلقى على ظهره وجعل رجله إلى القبلة وأومأ بالركوع والسجود وإن استلقى على جنبه ووجهه إلى القبلة وأومأ جاز فإن لم يستطع الإيماء برأسه أخر الصلاة ولا يومئ بعينه ولا بقلبه ولا بحاجبيه
cards.en: If he cannot sit, he lies on his back with his feet towards the qibla and nods for ruku and sujud. Lying on his side facing the qibla is also fine. If he cannot even nod his head, he delays the prayer; he does not signal with his eyes, his heart or his eyebrows.

cards.ask: If he can't do one, he moves to the next. Put them in order.
source: إذا تعذر على المريض القيام صلى قاعدا يركع ويسجد فإن لم يستطع الركوع والسجود أومأ إيماء برأسه
فإن لم يستطع القعود استلقى على ظهره
فإن لم يستطع الإيماء برأسه أخر الصلاة
cards.why: Standing, then sitting, then nodding, then lying down, and if even nodding is impossible, the prayer is delayed.

cards.ask: After an operation, Ali can stand but cannot bow or prostrate. Must he stand?
options: No: he may pray sitting, nodding
cards.source: فإن قدر على القيام ولم يقدر على الركوع والسجود لم يلزمه القيام وجاز أن يصلي قاعدا يومئ إيماء
cards.why: Standing is not required of someone who cannot bow and prostrate. He may sit and nod.

cards.ask: Sami was praying by nodding, then mid-prayer became able to bow and prostrate. What does he do?
options: Carry on with full ruku and sujud
source: فإن صلى الصحيح بعض صلاته قائما ثم حدث به مرض أتمها قاعدا
فإن صلى بإيماء ثم قدر على الركوع والسجود استأنف الصلاة
cards.why: Someone who falls ill mid-prayer finishes it sitting, but someone who was nodding and becomes able to bow starts again.

cards.ask: Hasan was unconscious for a day and a night: five prayers. When he recovers, what does he do?
options: Make up only the last one
cards.source: ومن أغمي عليه خمس صلوات فما دونها قضاها إذا صح فإن فاتته بالإغماء أكثر من ذلك لم يقض
cards.why: Five or fewer are made up. Only if he missed more than that through fainting does he not make them up.

cards.title: Sujud al-tilawa
cards.ar: سجود التلاوة في القرآن أربعة عشر: في آخر الأعراف وفي الرعد والنحل وبني إسرائيل ومريم والأولى من الحج والفرقان والنمل
cards.en: Sujud al-tilawa is one prostration on reciting certain ayat. There are fourteen places: the end of al-A'raf, al-Ra'd, al-Nahl, Bani Isra'il, Maryam, the first in al-Hajj, al-Furqan, al-Naml, Alif Lam Mim Tanzil, Sad, Ha Mim al-Sajda, al-Inshiqaq and al-'Alaq.

cards.title: Who must prostrate
cards.ar: والسجود واجب في هذه المواضع كلها على التالي والسامع سواء قصد سماع القرآن أولم يقصد وإذا تلا الإمام آية السجدة سجدها وسجد المأموم معه وإن تلا المأموم لم يسجد الإمام ولا المأموم
cards.en: This sujud is wajib on the one reciting and the one hearing, whether he meant to listen or not. If the imam recites a sajda ayah, he prostrates and the followers with him. If a follower recites it, neither the imam nor the follower prostrates.

cards.ask: During the prayer, the jama'a hears a man outside recite an ayah of sajda. What do they do?
options: Prostrate for it after the prayer
Prostrate at once, inside the prayer
cards.source: وإن سمعوا وهم في الصلاة آية سجدة من رجل ليس معهم في الصلاة لم يسجدوها في الصلاة وسجدوها بعد الصلاة فإن سجدوها في الصلاة لم تجزهم ولم فسد صلاتهم
cards.why: They prostrate after the prayer. If they did it inside the prayer, it would not count, though their prayer is not spoiled.

cards.ask: While memorising, Maryam recites the same sajda ayah three times in one sitting. How many sujud?
cards.source: ومن كرر تلاوة سجدة واحدة في مجلس واحد أجزأته سجدة واحدة
cards.why: Repeating one sajda ayah in one sitting needs just one sujud.

cards.ask: Which of these are right?

options.text: Sujud al-tilawa has no tashahhud and no salam
A sick person may signal with his eyes
If a follower recites a sajda ayah, nobody prostrates
A sick person lifts something to his face to prostrate on
Sujud al-tilawa is wajib even if you didn't mean to listen
For sujud al-tilawa, raise the hands at the takbir

source: ومن أراد السجود كبر ولم يرفع يديه وسجد ثم كبر ورفع رأسه ولا تشهد عليه ولا سلام
ولا يومئ بعينه
وإن تلا المأموم لم يسجد الإمام ولا المأموم
ولا يرفع إلى وجهه شيئا يسجد عليه
سواء قصد سماع القرآن أولم يقصد
cards.why: Sujud al-tilawa is a takbir without raising the hands, one sujud, a takbir up, and no tashahhud or salam. The sick do not signal with their eyes or lift things to their face.

cards.title: What counts as travel
cards.ar: مسيرة ثلاثة أيام ولياليها بسير الإبل ومشي الأقدام ولا يعتبر ذلك بالسير في الماء
cards.en: The journey that changes the rulings is one to a place three days and nights away at the pace of camels and people walking. It is not measured by travel on water.

cards.title: Two rak'ahs
cards.ar: وفرض المسافر عندنا: في كل صلاة رباعية ركعتان لا تجوز له الزيادة عليهما
cards.en: For us (the Hanafis), the traveller's fard in every four-rak'ah prayer is two rak'ahs, and he may not add to them.

cards.ask: Which prayers does the traveller shorten to two?
source: السفر الذي تتغير به الأحكام
في كل صلاة رباعية ركعتان
cards.why: Only the four-rak'ah prayers: Zuhr, Asr and Isha. Fajr and Maghrib stay as they are.

cards.ask: Ilyas, travelling, prays four for Zuhr, but he did sit for the tashahhud after the second. Does it count?
options: Yes: two are his fard, the other two are nafl
No, the whole prayer is void
cards.source: فإن صلى أربعا وقد قعد في الثانية مقدار التشهد أجزأته ركعتان عن فرضه وكانت الأخريان له نافلة وإن لم يقعد مقدار التشهد في الركعتين الأوليين بطلت صلاته
cards.why: Because he sat after two, his fard is done and the extra two are nafl. Had he not sat there, his prayer would be void.

cards.title: When it starts and ends
cards.ar: إذا فارق بيوت المصر ولا يزال على حكم السفر حتى ينوي الإقامة في بلد خمسة عشر يوما فصاعدا فيلزمه الإتمام وإن نوى الإقامة أقل من ذلك لم يتم
cards.en: He starts praying two once he has left the houses of his town behind. He stays a traveller until he intends to stay in a place fifteen days or more; then he must pray in full. If he intends to stay less than that, he still shortens.

cards.ask: How long must he intend to stay? Complete it.
cards.ar: حتى ينوي الإقامة في بلد ____ يوما فصاعدا
cards.source: حتى ينوي الإقامة في بلد خمسة عشر يوما فصاعدا
cards.why: Fifteen days or more. Less than that, he is still a traveller.

cards.ask: Hamid arrives in a city on business. Each day he says "I'll leave tomorrow", and this goes on for three months. How does he pray Zuhr?
options: Four, once fifteen days have passed
cards.source: ومن دخل بلدا ولم ينو أن يقيم فيه خمسة عشر يوما وإنما يقول غدا أخرج أو بعد غد أخرج حتى بقي على ذلك سنين صلى ركعتين
cards.why: He never intended fifteen days, so he keeps praying two, even if it lasts years.

cards.title: Armies, and praying behind a resident
cards.ar: وإذا دخل العسكر أرض الحرب فنووا الإقامة بها خمسة عشر يوما لم يتموا الصلاة وإذا دخل المسافر في صلاة المقيم مع بقاء الوقت أتم الصلاة وإن دخل معه في فائتة لم تجز صلاته خلفه
cards.en: An army in enemy land that intends to stay fifteen days still shortens. A traveller who joins a resident's prayer while its time remains prays it in full. But joining him in a make-up prayer is not valid.

cards.title: A travelling imam
cards.ar: وإذا صلى المسافر بالمقيمين ركعتين سلم ثم أتم المقيمون صلاتهم ويستحب له إذا سلم أن يقول: أتموا صلاتكم فإنا قوم سفر
cards.en: If a traveller leads residents, he says salam after two and the residents complete their prayer. It is liked for him to say after the salam: "Complete your prayer, for we are travellers."

cards.ask: A travelling imam leads residents in Asr and says salam after two rak'ahs. What do the residents do?
options: Say salam with him: two is enough
Start Asr again on their own
cards.source: سلم ثم أتم المقيمون صلاتهم
cards.why: The residents owe four, so they complete their own prayer after his salam.

cards.ask: Two rak'ahs or four?
items: A traveller behind a resident imam, in time
A traveller who has reached his home town
Visiting the old home he moved away from
Intending fifteen days split between Makka and Mina
A Zuhr missed on a journey, made up at home
A Zuhr missed at home, made up on a journey
A traveller whose journey is sinful
source: وإذا دخل المسافر في صلاة المقيم مع بقاء الوقت أتم الصلاة
أتم الصلاة وإن لم ينو الإقامة فيه
ومن كان له وطن فانتقل عنه واستوطن غيره ثم سافر فدخل وطنه الأول لم يتم الصلاة وإذا نوى المسافر أن يقيم بمكة ومنى خمسة عشر يوما لم يتم الصلاة
ومن فاتته صلاة في السفر قضاها في الحضر ركعتين
ومن فاتته صلاة في الحضر قضاها في السفر أربعا
والعاصي والمطيع في السفر في الرخصة سواء
cards.why: A make-up keeps the number it was due with. Home town and a resident imam mean four. An old home he left, Makka-and-Mina, and a sinful trip still mean two.

cards.title: Where Jumu'a is held
cards.ar: لا تصح الجمعة إلا بمصر جامع أو في مصلى المصر ولا تجوز في القرى
cards.en: Jumu'a (the Friday prayer) is only valid in a proper town (a misr jami') or in its prayer-ground, not in villages. It is only held by the ruler or someone he has appointed.

cards.title: Its time and its khutba
cards.ar: ومن شرائطها: الوقت فتصح في الوقت ولا تصح بعده ومن شرائطها الخطبة قبل الصلاة يخطب الإمام خطبتين يفصل بينهما بقعدة ويخطب قائما على طهارة
cards.en: Among its conditions: the time. It is valid in Zuhr's time, not after it. And the khutba (sermon) before the prayer: the imam gives two khutbas with a sitting between them, standing and in a state of purity.

cards.ask: Which are conditions of Jumu'a?
source: لا تصح الجمعة إلا بمصر جامع
ومن شرائطها: الوقت
ومن شرائطها الخطبة قبل الصلاة
ومن شرائطها: الجماعة
cards.why: Town, time, a khutba before, and a jama'a. The khutba comes before the prayer, not after.

cards.title: The khutba and the jama'a
cards.ar: فإن اقتصر على ذكر الله تعالى جاز عند أبي حنيفة وقال أبو يوسف ومحمد: لا بد من ذكر طويل يسمى خطبة وإن خطب قاعدا أو على غير طهارة جاز ويكره ومن شرائطها: الجماعة وأقلهم عند أبي حنيفة ثلاثة سوى الإمام وقال أبو يوسف ومحمد: اثنان سوى الإمام ويجهر الإمام بالقراءة في الركعتين
cards.en: For Abu Hanifa a mere mention of Allah is enough for the khutba; giving it sitting or without purity counts but is makruh. Its jama'a is, for Abu Hanifa, at least three besides the imam. The imam recites aloud in both rak'ahs, and there is no fixed surah. Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad want a long remembrance that can be called a khutba, and two besides the imam.

cards.ask: The imam gives the Jumu'a khutba sitting down, without wudu. Is it valid?
cards.source: وإن خطب قاعدا أو على غير طهارة جاز ويكره
cards.why: It counts, but it is makruh.

cards.title: Who must attend
cards.ar: ولا تجب الجمعة على مسافر ولا امرأة ولا مريض ولا عبد ولا أعمى فإن حضروا وصلوا مع الناس أجزاهم عن فرض الوقت ويجوز للمسافر والعبد والمريض ونحوهم أن يؤم في الجمعة
cards.en: Jumu'a is not obligatory on a traveller, a woman, a sick person, a slave or a blind person. If they come and pray it with the people, it counts as that time's fard. A traveller, slave, sick person and the like may even lead Jumu'a.

cards.ask: Ahmad is travelling, but he prays Jumu'a with the people. Must he also pray Zuhr?
options: No: Jumu'a counts as that time's fard
cards.source: فإن حضروا وصلوا مع الناس أجزاهم عن فرض الوقت
cards.why: Jumu'a was not obligatory on him, but once he prayed it, it counts for the time.

cards.title: Praying Zuhr at home instead
cards.ar: ومن صلى الظهر في منزله يوم الجمعة قبل صلاة الإمام ولا عذر له كره له ذلك وجازت صلاته فإن بدا له أن يحضر الجمعة فتوجه إليها بطلب صلاة الظهر عند أبي حنيفة بالسعي وقال أبو يوسف ومحمد: لا تبطل حتى يدخل مع الإمام
cards.en: Whoever prays Zuhr at home on Friday before the imam's prayer, without an excuse, has done something makruh, though the prayer counts. If he then sets off for Jumu'a, for Abu Hanifa his Zuhr is cancelled by setting off. Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad say not until he joins the imam.

cards.ask: On Friday, some men too ill to go to the mosque want to pray Zuhr together in jama'a at home. What does al-Quduri say?
options: It is makruh for them to pray Zuhr in jama'a
They must hold their own Jumu'a
cards.source: ويكره أن يصلي المعذورون الظهر بجماعة يوم الجمعة وكذلك أهل السجن
cards.why: Those with an excuse, and those in prison, pray Zuhr on Friday but not in jama'a: that is makruh.

cards.title: Arriving late
cards.ar: ومن أدرك الإمام يوم الجمعة صلى معه ما أدرك وبنى عليها الجمعة
cards.en: Whoever catches the imam on Friday prays with him what he catches and completes Jumu'a. For Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf this holds even if he catches him in the tashahhud or the sujud al-sahw. Note: Muhammad says that if he caught most of the second rak'ah he completes Jumu'a; if less, he completes Zuhr.

cards.ask: The first adhan of Jumu'a is called while Faisal is selling in his shop. What should he do?
options: Stop selling and head to Jumu'a
Keep selling until the khutba starts
cards.source: وإذا أذن المؤذنون يوم الجمعة الأذان الأول ترك الناس البيع والشراء وتوجهوا إلى صلاة الجمعة
cards.why: At the first adhan people leave buying and selling and set off for Jumu'a.

cards.ask: Put Friday in order
steps: The first adhan: people stop trading
The imam climbs the minbar and sits
The adhan in front of the minbar
source: وإذا أذن المؤذنون يوم الجمعة الأذان الأول ترك الناس البيع والشراء
وإذا خرج الإمام على المنبر يوم الجمعة ترك الناس الصلاة والكلام حتى يفرغ من خطبته
فإذا صعد الإمام المنبر جلس وأذن المؤذنون بين يدي المنبر فإذا فرغ من خطبته أقاموا الصلاة وصلوا
cards.why: First adhan, the imam sits on the minbar, the adhan before him, the khutba with no prayer or talk, then the iqama and the prayer.

cards.title: The morning of Eid al-Fitr
cards.ar: ويستحب في يوم الفطر: أن يطعم الإنسان قبل الخروج إلى المصلى ويغتسل ويتطيب ويتوجه إلى المصلى ولا يكبر في طريق المصلى عند أبي حنيفة وعندها يكبر
cards.en: On Eid al-Fitr it is liked to eat something before going out to the musalla (the prayer-ground), to bathe, to wear perfume, and to go to the musalla. For Abu Hanifa he does not say takbir on the way. Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad say he does.

cards.title: Its time
cards.ar: فإذا حلت الصلاة من ارتفاع الشمس دخل وقتها إلى الزوال فإذا زالت الشمس خرج وقتها
cards.en: No nafl is prayed at the musalla before the Eid prayer. Its time comes in once the sun has risen high, and lasts until midday (zawal). When the sun passes its height, the time is over.

cards.ask: At the musalla on Eid al-Fitr, Rashid wants to pray two nafl rak'ahs while waiting for the Eid prayer. What does al-Quduri say?
options: No nafl is prayed at the musalla before Eid
Two rak'ahs of greeting are sunnah
cards.source: ولا يتنقل في المصلى قبل صلاة العيد
cards.why: He says there is no nafl at the musalla before the Eid prayer.

cards.title: How it is prayed
cards.ar: ويصلي الإمام بالناس ركعتين: يكبر في الأولى تكبيرة الأفتتاح وثلاثا بعدها ثم يقرأ فاتحة الكتاب وسورة معها ثم يكبر تكبيرة يركع بها ثم يبتدئ في الركعة الثانية بالقراءة كبر ثلاث تكبيرات وكبر تكبيرة رابعة يركع بها
cards.en: The imam leads two rak'ahs. In the first: the opening takbir and three more, then al-Fatiha and a surah, then a takbir to go into ruku. In the second he starts with the recitation, then says three takbirs, and a fourth to go into ruku.

cards.ask: Put the Eid prayer in order
source: يكبر في الأولى تكبيرة الأفتتاح وثلاثا بعدها ثم يقرأ فاتحة الكتاب وسورة معها ثم يكبر تكبيرة يركع بها
ثم يبتدئ في الركعة الثانية بالقراءة كبر ثلاث تكبيرات وكبر تكبيرة رابعة يركع بها
ثم يخطب بعد الصلاة خطبتين
cards.why: In the first rak'ah the takbirs come before the recitation; in the second, after it. The khutbas come after the prayer.

cards.title: The khutba; missing it
cards.ar: ويرفع يديه في تكبيرات العيدين ثم يخطب بعد الصلاة خطبتين يعلم الناس فيها صدقة الفطر وأحكامها ومن فاتته صلاة العيد مع الإمام لم يقضها
cards.en: He raises his hands at the Eid takbirs. After the prayer the imam gives two khutbas, teaching people sadaqat al-fitr (the Eid charity) and its rules. Whoever misses the Eid prayer with the imam does not make it up.

cards.ask: On the 30th, it was cloudy. After midday, witnesses tell the imam they saw the new moon. What about the Eid prayer?
options: It is prayed the next day
There is no Eid prayer this year
cards.source: فإن غم الهلال على الناس فشهدوا عند الإمام برؤية الهلال بعد الزوال صلى العيد من الغد فإن حدث عذر منع الناس من الصلاة في اليوم الثاني لم يصلها بعده
cards.why: Its time ended at midday, so it is prayed the next day. If something stops it on that second day too, it is not prayed after that.

cards.title: Eid al-Adha
cards.ar: ويستحب في يوم الأضحى: أن يغتسل ويتطيب ويؤخر الأكل حتى يفرغ من الصلاة ويتوجه إلى المصلى وهو يكبر
cards.en: On Eid al-Adha it is liked to bathe and wear perfume, to put off eating until after the prayer, and to go to the musalla saying takbir. It is two rak'ahs like Eid al-Fitr; the khutba teaches the udhiyya (sacrifice) and the takbirs of tashriq. If an excuse stops it, it can be prayed the next day or the day after, but no later.

cards.ask: Eid al-Fitr or Eid al-Adha?
items: Put off eating until after the prayer
Can still be prayed two days late
source: أن يطعم الإنسان قبل الخروج إلى المصلى
ويؤخر الأكل حتى يفرغ من الصلاة ويتوجه إلى المصلى وهو يكبر
يعلم الناس فيها صدقة الفطر
ويصلي الأضحى ركعتين كصلاة الفطر ويخطب بعدها خطبيتن يعلم الناس فيهما الأضحية وتكبيرات التشريق فإن حدث عذر منع الناس من الصلاة في يوم الأضحى صلاها من الغد وبعد الغد ولا يصليها بعد ذلك
cards.why: Fitr: eat first, khutba on its charity. Adha: eat after, takbir on the way, khutba on the sacrifice, and up to two days' delay with an excuse.

cards.title: The takbirs of tashriq
cards.ar: وتكبير التشريق أوله عقيب صلاة الفجر من يوم عرفة وآخره عقيب صلاة العصر من النحر عند أبي حنيفة وقال أبو يوسف ومحمد: إلى صلاة العصر من آخر أيام التشريق
cards.en: The takbir of tashriq is said after the fard prayers. It starts after Fajr on the day of 'Arafa and, for Abu Hanifa, ends after Asr on the day of sacrifice (Eid day). Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad say it lasts until Asr on the last day of tashriq.

cards.ask: Complete the takbir of tashriq.
cards.ar: والتكبير عقيب الصلوات المفروضات وهو أن يقول: الله أكبر الله أكبر لا إله إلا الله ____ الله أكبر ولله الحمد
cards.source: الله أكبر الله أكبر لا إله إلا الله والله أكبر الله أكبر ولله الحمد
cards.why: Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahil-hamd.

cards.ask: Which are right about the Eid prayers?

options.text: The khutba comes before the prayer
Raise the hands at the extra takbirs
Its time starts once the sun has risen high
A missed Eid prayer is made up alone

source: ويصلي الإمام بالناس ركعتين
ويرفع يديه في تكبيرات العيدين ثم يخطب بعد الصلاة خطبتين
فإذا حلت الصلاة من ارتفاع الشمس دخل وقتها إلى الزوال
ومن فاتته صلاة العيد مع الإمام لم يقضها
cards.why: Two rak'ahs, hands raised at the takbirs, from the risen sun to midday. The khutba is after, and a missed one is not made up.

lessons.title: Eclipse, rain, tarawih and fear prayers

cards.title: The eclipse prayer
cards.ar: إذا انكسفت الشمس صلى الإمام بالناس ركعتين كهيئة النافلة في كل ركعة ركوع واحد ويطول القراءة فيهما ويخفي عند أبي حنيفة وقال أبو يوسف ومحمد: يجهر ثم يدعو بعدها حتى تنجلي الشمس
cards.en: When the sun is eclipsed, the imam leads two rak'ahs like a nafl prayer, with one ruku in each, and makes the recitation long. For Abu Hanifa it is quiet. Afterwards he makes du'a until the sun clears. Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad say it is aloud.

cards.title: Who leads; the moon
cards.ar: ويصلي بالناس الإمام الذي يصلي بهم الجمعة فإن لم يجمع صلاها الناس فرادى وليس في خسوف القمر جماعة وإنما يصلي كل واحد بنفسه وليس في الكسوف خطبة
cards.en: The imam who leads Jumu'a leads it. If he doesn't gather them, people pray it alone. For an eclipse of the moon there is no jama'a: each person prays by himself. There is no khutba for an eclipse.

cards.ask: Which are true of the eclipse prayers?

options.text: A jama'a for an eclipse of the moon

source: ركعتين كهيئة النافلة في كل ركعة ركوع واحد ويطول القراءة فيهما
وليس في خسوف القمر جماعة
وليس في الكسوف خطبة
cards.why: Two long rak'ahs with one ruku each. No khutba, and the moon's eclipse is prayed alone.

cards.title: Praying for rain
cards.ar: قال أبو حنيفة رحمه الله عليه: ليس في الاستسقاء صلاة مسنونة في جماعة فإن صلى الناس وحدانا جاز وإنما الاستسقاء الدعاء والاستغفار
cards.en: Istisqa is asking Allah for rain. Abu Hanifa said it has no sunnah prayer in jama'a; if people pray alone, that is fine. Istisqa is du'a and asking forgiveness.

cards.title: The two companions on istisqa
cards.ar: وقال أبو يوسف ومحمد: يصلي الإمام بالناس ركعتين يجهر فيهما بالقراءة
cards.en: Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad say the imam leads two rak'ahs with the recitation aloud. He faces the qibla for the du'a and turns his cloak inside out, but the people do not turn theirs. Ahl al-dhimma (non-Muslims living under Muslim rule) do not attend.

cards.ask: During a drought, the people of Hamid's town each pray on their own, asking for rain. Is that allowed?
options: No: it must be in jama'a
No: istisqa has no prayer at all
cards.source: فإن صلى الناس وحدانا جاز
cards.why: Al-Quduri says that if people pray alone for rain, it is allowed.

cards.title: Tarawih in Ramadan
cards.ar: يستحب أن يجتمع الناس في شهر رمضان بعد العشاء فيصلي بهم إمامهم خمس ترويحات
cards.en: In Ramadan it is liked for people to gather after Isha, and their imam leads them in five tarwihas. Each tarwiha is two salams (four rak'ahs), with a rest between them as long as a tarwiha. Then he leads them in witr.

cards.ask: In Sha'ban, Idris's friends want to pray witr together in jama'a. What does al-Quduri say?
options: Witr is not prayed in jama'a outside Ramadan
cards.source: ثم يوتر بهم ولا يصلي الوتر بجماعة في غير شهر رمضان
cards.why: Witr in jama'a belongs to Ramadan only.

cards.title: The fear prayer
cards.ar: إذا اشتد الخوف جعل الإمام الناس طائفتين: طائفة في وجه العدو وطائفة خلفه فيصلي بهذه الطائفة ركعة وسجدتين فإذا رفع رأسه من السجدة الثانية مضت هذه الطائفة إلى وجه العدو وجاءت تلك الطائفة
cards.en: When fear is great, the imam splits the people into two groups: one faces the enemy, one prays behind him. He prays one rak'ah with this group; when he rises from its second sujud they go to face the enemy, and the other group comes.

cards.ask: A two-rak'ah fear prayer: put it in order
steps: Group A prays one rak'ah with the imam
A goes to face the enemy; B comes
B prays the second rak'ah; the imam says salam
B goes; A returns and finishes alone, without recitation
A goes; B returns and finishes, with recitation
source: فيصلي بهم الإمام ركعة وسجدتين وتشهد وسلم ولم يسلموا وذهبوا إلى وجه العدو وجاءت الطائفة الأولى فصلوا وحدانا ركعة وسجدتين بغير قراءة وتشهدوا وسلموا ومضوا إلى وجه العدو وجاءت الطائفة الأخرى فصلوا ركعة وسجدتين بقراءة وتشهدوا وسلموا
cards.why: The first group finishes without recitation (they started behind the imam). The second finishes with recitation.

cards.ask: The imam is a resident (not travelling) and leads Maghrib in fear. How does he divide it?
options: Two rak'ahs with the first group, one with the second
One with the first, two with the second
cards.source: فإن كان الإمام مقميا صلى بالطائفة الأولى ركعتين وبالثانية ركعتين ويصلي بالطائفة الأولى ركعتين من المغرب وبالثانية ركعة
cards.why: In Maghrib the first group gets two and the second one. In a four-rak'ah prayer each gets two.

cards.ask: Which of these are right?

options.text: Fighting during the fear prayer spoils it
In very great fear they pray riding, alone, nodding
The first group finishes with recitation
The moon's eclipse is prayed in jama'a

source: ولا يقاتلون في حال الصلاة فإن فعلوا ذلك بطلت صلاتهم وإن اشتد الخوف صلوا ركبانا وحدانا يومئون بالركوع والسجود إلى أي جهة شاءوا إذا لم يقدروا على التوجه إلى القبلة
بغير قراءة
فيصلي بهم إمامهم خمس ترويحات
وإنما يصلي كل واحد بنفسه
cards.why: Fighting voids the prayer; in extreme fear they pray riding, alone, any direction. The first group finishes without recitation, and the moon's eclipse is prayed alone.

cards.title: At the time of death
cards.ar: إذا احتضر الرجل وجه إلى القبلة على شقة الأيمن ولقن الشهادتين فإذا مات شدوا لحييته وغمضوا عينيه وإذا أرادوا غسله وضعوه على سرير وجعلوا على عورته خرقة
cards.en: When someone is dying, turn him to the qibla on his right side and gently prompt him with the shahada. When he dies, tie up his jaw and close his eyes. To wash him, lay him on a raised bed and put a cloth over his 'awra.

cards.title: Washing the body
cards.ar: ولا يمضمض ولا يستنشق ثم يفيضون الماء عليه ويجمر سريره وترا ويغلى الماء بالسدر أو بالحرض فإن لم يكن فالماء القراح ويغتسل رأسه ولحيته بالخطمي
cards.en: They take off his clothes and give him wudu, but without rinsing the mouth or nose, then pour water over him. The bed is perfumed with incense an odd number of times. The water is boiled with sidr (lote leaves) or hurud (a plant soap), or else plain water is used. His head and beard are washed with khitmi (a cleansing plant).

cards.ask: Put the washing in order
steps: Wash the head and beard with khitmi
Lay him on his left side and wash
Lay him on his right side and wash
Sit him up and wipe his belly gently
source: ونزعوا ثيابه
ويغتسل رأسه ولحيته بالخطمي
ثم يضجع على شقه الأيسر فيغتسل بالماء والسدر حتى يرى أن الماء قد وصل إلى ما يلي التخت منه ثم يضجع على شقة الأيمن
ثم يجلسه ويسنده إليه
ثم ينشفه بثوب
cards.why: Wudu and head first, then the left side, then the right, then sitting him up, then drying.

cards.ask: While the belly is being wiped, something comes out of the body. What do they do?
options: Wash it away, without repeating the whole washing
cards.source: فإن خرج منه شيء غسله ولا يعيد غسله
cards.why: They wash off what came out; the washing itself is not repeated.

cards.title: The shroud
cards.ar: ويجعل الحنوط على رأسه ولحيته والكافور على مساجده والسنة أن يكفن الرجل في ثلاثة أثواب: إزار وقميص ولفافة فإن اقتصروا على ثوبين جاز
cards.en: Put hanut (a burial perfume) on his head and beard, and camphor on the places that touch the ground in sujud. The sunnah is to shroud a man in three cloths: a wrap for the lower body, a shirt, and a full sheet. Two cloths are also enough.

cards.ask: Wrapping the sheet around the body, which side do they fold over first?
source: ابتداءوا بالجانب الأيسر فألقوه عليه ثم بالأيمن فإن خافوا أن ينشر الكفن عنه عقدوه
cards.why: They start with the left side, then the right, and tie it if they fear it will open.

cards.ask: A man's shroud or a woman's?
items: A cloth to bind the chest
The hair laid on the chest
source: والسنة أن يكفن الرجل في ثلاثة أثواب
فإن اقتصروا على ثوبين جاز
وتكفن المرأة في خمسة أثواب: إزار وقميص وخمار وخرقة يربط بها ثدياها ولفافة
ثلاثة أثواب جاز ويكون الخمار فوق القميص تحت اللفافة ويجعل شعرها على صدرها
cards.why: A man: three, or two at least. A woman: five, with a khimar and a chest cloth, her hair on her chest; three are enough for her.

cards.title: Who leads the janaza prayer
cards.ar: فإذا فرغوا منه صلوا عليه وأولى الناس بالصلاة عليه السلطان إن حضر فإن لم يحضر فيستحب تقديم إمام الحي ثم الولي فإن صلى عليه غير الولي والسلطان أعاد الولي وإن صلى الولي لم يجز لأحد أن يصلي بعده فإن دفن ولم يصل عليه صلي على قبره
cards.en: Then they pray over him. The ruler, if present, has most right to lead; if not, the local imam is liked, then the wali (nearest male relative). If someone other than the wali or ruler led, the wali may pray again; if the wali led, nobody else may pray after. If he was buried without a prayer, they pray at his grave.

cards.ask: Put the janaza prayer in order
steps: First takbir, then praise of Allah
Second takbir, then salawat on the Prophet ﷺ
Third takbir, then du'a for oneself, the dead and the Muslims
source: والصلاة: أن يكبر تكبيرة يحمد الله تعالى عقيبها ثم يكبر تكبيرة ويصلي على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
ثم يكبر تكبيرة رابعة ويسلم ولا يصلى على ميت في مسجد جماعة
cards.why: Four takbirs: praise, salawat, du'a, then salam. It is not prayed in a congregational mosque.

cards.title: Carrying and burial
cards.ar: فإذا حملوه على سريره أخذوا بقوائمه الأربع ويمشون به مسرعين دون الخبب فإذا بلغوا إلى قبره كره للناس أن يجلسوا قبل أن يوضع عن أعناق الرجال
cards.en: They carry the bier by its four legs and walk quickly, but not at a run. At the grave it is makruh to sit before the bier is lowered from the men's shoulders. A lahd (side niche) is dug, the body is placed from the qibla side, with "Bismillah wa 'ala millati rasulillah", faced to the qibla, and the knots untied.

cards.ask: A baby cries out at birth and then dies. What is done?
options: He is named, washed and prayed over
Wrapped in a cloth, with no prayer
cards.source: ومن استهل بعد الولادة سمي وغسل وصلي عليه وإن لم يستهل أدرج في خرقه ولم يصل عليه
cards.why: A baby who made a sound after birth is named, washed and prayed over. One who did not is wrapped in a cloth without a prayer.

cards.ask: Which of these are right?

options.text: Carry the bier quickly, but not at a run
If the wali has prayed, nobody prays after him
Baked bricks over the body are makruh

source: ويمشون به مسرعين دون الخبب
وإن صلى الولي لم يجز لأحد أن يصلي بعده
ويسوي اللبن عليه ويكره الآجر والخشب ولا بأس بالقصب ثم ينهال التراب عليه ويسنم القبر
ولا يسرح شعر الميت
cards.why: Quick walking, the wali's prayer being final, and makruh baked bricks are right. The grave is humped, not flat, and the dead person's hair is not combed.

lessons.title: The shahid, and prayer in the Ka'ba

cards.title: Who is a shahid
cards.ar: الشهيد: من قتله المشركون أو وجد في المعركة وبه أثر الجراحة أو قتله المسلمون ظلما ولم تجب بقتله دية
cards.en: A shahid (martyr) is one killed by the mushrikin (those who worship others with Allah), or found on the battlefield bearing wounds, or killed unjustly by Muslims in a way that brings no diya (blood-money).

cards.ask: Who counts as a shahid here?

options.text: Found on the battlefield with wounds
Killed unjustly by Muslims, with no diya due
Killed for a hadd or in qisas
Died of an illness at home

source: الشهيد: من قتله المشركون أو وجد في المعركة وبه أثر الجراحة أو قتله المسلمون ظلما ولم تجب بقتله دية
ومن قتل في حد أو قصاص غسل وصلي عليه
cards.why: The first three are al-Quduri's definition. Someone killed in a hadd or qisas is washed and prayed over like others.

cards.title: How the shahid is treated
cards.ar: فيكفن ويصلي عيه ولا يغتسل وإذا استشهد الجنب غسل عند أبي حنيفة وكذلك الصبي وقال أبو يوسف ومحمد: لا يغسلان ولا يغتسل عن الشهيد دمه ولا ينزع عنه ثيابه
cards.en: The shahid is shrouded and prayed over, but not washed. His blood is not washed off and his clothes are not taken off, though fur, leather socks, padding and weapons are removed. For Abu Hanifa a shahid who was junub is washed, and so is a child. Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad say neither is washed.

cards.title: When he is washed after all
cards.ar: ومن ارتث غسل والارتثات: أن يأكل أو يشرب أو يداوى أو يبقى حيا حتى يمضي عليه وقت صلاة وهو يعقل أو ينقل من المعركة حيا
cards.en: If he was "irtathth", he is washed. That means: he ate, drank or was treated, or lived, conscious, through a whole prayer time, or was carried off the battlefield alive.

cards.ask: Washed, or not washed?
items: Killed by the enemy in battle
Wounded, then ate and drank before dying
Killed unjustly by Muslims, no diya due
source: فيكفن ويصلي عيه ولا يغتسل
ومن ارتث غسل والارتثات: أن يأكل أو يشرب
أو ينقل من المعركة حيا
ومن قتل في حد أو قصاص غسل وصلي عليه
cards.why: The shahid is not washed. One who ate, drank or was carried off alive is washed, and so is one killed in qisas.

cards.ask: A highway robber is killed during a raid. Is the janaza prayer said for him?
options: Yes, but he is not washed
cards.source: ومن قتل من البغاة أو قطاع الطريق لم يصل عليه
cards.why: Rebels and highway robbers who are killed are not prayed over.

cards.title: Prayer inside the Ka'ba
cards.ar: الصلاة في الكعبة جائزة فرضها ونفلها
cards.en: Praying inside the Ka'ba is allowed, fard and nafl. If an imam leads a jama'a there and some have their backs to the imam's back, it is fine. But whoever has his back to the imam's face, his prayer does not count.

cards.ask: Inside the Ka'ba, Hasan stands with his back towards the imam's face. Does his prayer count?
cards.source: ومن جعل منهم ظهره إلى وجه الإمام لم تجز صلاته
cards.why: Standing in front of the imam, back to his face, means he is ahead of the imam, so it does not count.

cards.title: Around the Ka'ba
cards.ar: وإذا صلى الإمام في المسجد الحرام تحلق الناس حول الكعبة وصلوا بصلاة الإمام فمن كان منهم أقرب إلى الكعبة من الإمام جازت صلاته إذا لم يكن في جانب الإمام
cards.en: When the imam prays in the Masjid al-Haram, people form circles around the Ka'ba and follow him. Someone closer to the Ka'ba than the imam is fine, as long as he is not on the imam's own side.

cards.ask: In the Haram, Bilal stands closer to the Ka'ba than the imam, but on a different side. Does his prayer count?
options: No: nobody may be closer than the imam
cards.source: فمن كان منهم أقرب إلى الكعبة من الإمام جازت صلاته إذا لم يكن في جانب الإمام
cards.why: Being closer is fine as long as he is not on the imam's side.

cards.ask: Which of these are right?

options.text: A fard prayer inside the Ka'ba counts
Praying on the roof of the Ka'ba counts
Closer to the Ka'ba than the imam on the imam's own side counts
The shahid's blood is washed off

source: الصلاة في الكعبة جائزة فرضها ونفلها
ومن صلى على ظهر الكعبة جازت صلاته
إذا لم يكن في جانب الإمام
ولا يغتسل عن الشهيد دمه
فيكفن ويصلي عيه
cards.why: Fard inside, and on the roof, both count; the shahid is prayed over. Being ahead on the imam's side does not count, and the shahid's blood is left.

lessons.title: Making a nikah: offer, acceptance, witnesses

cards.title: Offer and acceptance
cards.ar: النكاح ينعقد بالإيجاب والقبول بلفظين يعبر بهما عن الماضي أو يعبر بأحدهما عن الماضي وبالآخر عن المستقبل مثل أن يقول: زوجتي فيقول زوجتك
cards.en: A nikah (the marriage contract) is made by an offer (ijab) and an acceptance (qabul). Both phrases can be in the past tense, like "I have married you", or one can be past and the other about the future. For example, one asks "Marry me", and the other answers "I have married you".

cards.ask: What makes a nikah? Complete it.
cards.ar: النكاح ينعقد بالإيجاب ____
cards.source: النكاح ينعقد بالإيجاب والقبول
cards.why: والقبول: a nikah is made by an offer and an acceptance.

cards.title: Two witnesses
cards.ar: ولا يعقد نكاح المسلمين إلا بحضور شاهدين حرين بالغين عاقلين مسلمين أو رجل وامرأتين
cards.en: A nikah between Muslims is only made in front of two witnesses. They must be free, adult, sane and Muslim: two men, or one man and two women.

cards.title: Even if not known as upright
cards.ar: عدولا كانوا
cards.en: The witnesses count whether or not they are known as upright ('adl) people, and even if they were once punished for qadhf (falsely accusing someone of zina, unlawful relations).

cards.ask: Yusuf and Maryam make their nikah. The only witness is Maryam's friend Hafsa, an adult Muslim woman. Is the nikah made?
options: No: one woman alone is not enough
Yes: one Muslim witness is enough
Yes, if Hafsa is known as upright
cards.source: إلا بحضور شاهدين حرين بالغين عاقلين مسلمين أو رجل وامرأتين
cards.why: The book needs two witnesses, or one man and two women. One woman alone does not make the nikah.

cards.ask: Which of these can be the witnesses of a Muslim nikah?

options.text: Two free, adult, sane Muslim men
One Muslim man and two Muslim women
Two Muslim men not known as upright
One Muslim man on his own

source: شاهدين حرين بالغين عاقلين مسلمين أو رجل
عدولا كانوا
cards.why: Two adult Muslim men, or one man and two women, even if they are not known as upright. Children and a single man are not enough.

cards.title: A Muslim man marrying a dhimmi woman
cards.ar: فإن تزوج مسلم ذمية بشهادة ذميين جاز عند أبي حنيفة وأبي يوسف وقال محمد: لا يجوز
cards.en: A dhimmi is a Jew or Christian living under Muslim rule. If a Muslim man marries a dhimmi woman with two dhimmi witnesses, it is valid for Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf. Note: Muhammad says it is not valid.

cards.title: Which words make a nikah
cards.ar: وينعقد النكاح بلفظ النكاح والتزويج والتمليك والهبة والصدقة ولا ينعقد بلفظ الإجارة والإباحة
cards.en: A nikah is made with the words nikah, tazwij (marrying), tamlik (giving ownership), hiba (giving as a gift) and sadaqa (giving in charity). It is not made with the words ijara (hiring) or ibaha (allowing).

cards.ask: Does this word make a nikah?
cards.source: وينعقد النكاح بلفظ النكاح والتزويج والتمليك والهبة والصدقة ولا ينعقد بلفظ الإجارة والإباحة
cards.why: Nikah, tazwij, tamlik, hiba and sadaqa make a nikah. Ijara and ibaha do not.

cards.ask: Ali says to Zaynab's father, before two adult Muslim men, "Marry your daughter to me", and with her consent he answers "I have married her to you". Is the nikah made?
options: Yes: an offer, an acceptance and two witnesses
No: both phrases must be in the past tense
No: the word "marry" cannot make a nikah
source: أو يعبر بأحدهما عن الماضي وبالآخر عن المستقبل
ولا يعقد نكاح المسلمين إلا بحضور شاهدين
cards.why: One phrase may be about the future and the other past, and two witnesses were there, so the nikah is made.

lessons.title: Whom a man may never marry
lessons.arabic: ولا يحل للرجل أن يتزوج بأمه

cards.title: Close family by blood
cards.ar: ولا يحل للرجل أن يتزوج بأمه ولا بجداته من قبل الرجال والنساء ولا ببنته ولا ببنت ولده وإن سفلت ولا بأخته ولا ببنات أخته ولا ببنات أخيه ولا بعمته
cards.en: A man may never marry his mother, his grandmothers on his father's or mother's side, his daughter, his granddaughters however many generations down, his sister, his sister's or brother's daughters, or his father's sister.

cards.ask: Granddaughters however far... Complete it.
cards.ar: ولا ببنت ولده وإن ____
cards.source: ولا ببنت ولده وإن سفلت
cards.why: وإن سفلت: however many generations down she is, she is forbidden.

cards.title: Family through marriage
cards.ar: بخالته ولا بأم دخل بابنتها أو لم يدخل ولا ببنت امرأته التي دخل بها سواء كانت في حجره أو في حجر غيره ولا بامرأة أبيه وأجداده ولا بامرأة ابنه وبني أولاده
cards.en: Nor his mother's sister. Nor his wife's mother, whether or not the marriage was consummated (dukhul: the couple have been together as husband and wife). Nor his wife's daughter, once the marriage with her mother was consummated, whether she grew up in his home or not. Nor the wives of his father or grandfathers, or of his sons or grandsons.

cards.ask: Khalid married Huda, but they divorced before they were ever together as husband and wife. May Khalid now marry Huda's mother?
options: No: a wife's mother is forbidden either way
cards.source: ولا بأم دخل بابنتها أو لم يدخل
cards.why: A wife's mother is forbidden whether or not the marriage was consummated.

cards.ask: Khalid's divorce from Huda came before any dukhul. Huda has a daughter, Sana, from an earlier marriage. May Khalid marry Sana?
options: Yes: a wife's daughter is forbidden only after dukhul with her mother
No: a wife's daughter is always forbidden
No, because Sana grew up away from him
cards.source: ولا ببنت امرأته التي دخل بها
cards.why: The book forbids the daughter of a wife "he has been with". Here there was no dukhul, so Sana is not forbidden.

cards.title: Milk relations
cards.ar: ولا بأمه من الرضاعة
cards.en: Nor his milk-mother: a woman who breastfed him as a baby (rada'a). The book goes on to name milk-siblings too.

cards.ask: Which of these may a man never marry?
source: بخالته ولا بأم دخل بابنتها أو لم يدخل
ولا بامرأة أبيه وأجداده ولا بامرأة ابنه
cards.why: His maternal aunt, his wife's mother, his father's wife and his son's wife are all named. A cousin is not in the list.

cards.ask: Forbidden to him, or not?
source: ولا بعمته
ولا بأمه من الرضاعة
ولا بأم دخل بابنتها أو لم يدخل ولا ببنت امرأته التي دخل بها
cards.why: Aunt, milk-mother and wife's mother are forbidden. The wife's daughter is forbidden only after dukhul. A cousin is not named.

cards.ask: Umar's son divorced his wife Rania. May Umar marry Rania?
options: No: a son's wife is forbidden to him
Yes, once her iddah is over
Yes, if there was no dukhul
cards.source: ولا بامرأة ابنه وبني أولاده
cards.why: The wife of his son or grandson is forbidden to him, so Umar may not marry Rania.

lessons.title: Who may not be married together

cards.title: Two sisters, or a woman and her aunt
cards.ar: ولا يجمع بين أختين بنكاح ولا بملك يمين وطئا ولا يجمع بين المرأة وبين عمتها وخالتها ولا ابنة أخيها ولا ابنة أختها
cards.en: A man may not be married to two sisters at the same time. Nor may he be married at once to a woman and her aunt (father's or mother's sister), or a woman and her niece.

cards.ask: Omar is married to Amina. May he also marry Amina's sister Safa while Amina is his wife?
options: No: two sisters may not be married together
cards.source: ولا يجمع بين أختين بنكاح
cards.why: Two sisters may never be his wives at the same time.

cards.title: The general rule
cards.ar: ولا يجمع بين امرأتين لو كانت كل واحدة منهما رجلا لم يجز له أن يتزوج بالأخرى ولا بأس أن يجمع بين امرأة وابنة زوج كان لها من قبل
cards.en: The rule: two women may not be married to one man together if, were either of them a man, he could not marry the other. But there is no harm in marrying a woman and the daughter of her former husband (from another wife) together.

cards.ask: Hassan is married to Layla. Layla's former husband has a daughter, Nour, from a different wife. May Hassan marry Nour as well?
options: No: they are like mother and daughter
No: they are like two sisters
cards.source: ولا بأس أن يجمع بين امرأة وابنة زوج كان لها من قبل
cards.why: The book says there is no harm in marrying a woman and her former husband's daughter together.

cards.ask: Which pairs may NOT be one man's wives at the same time?

options.text: A woman and her father's sister
A woman and her mother's sister
A woman and her brother's daughter
A woman and her former husband's daughter
Two women who are not related

source: ولا يجمع بين أختين
ولا يجمع بين المرأة وبين عمتها وخالتها ولا ابنة أخيها ولا ابنة أختها
ولا بأس أن يجمع بين امرأة وابنة زوج كان لها من قبل
cards.why: Sisters, aunt and niece may not be combined. A woman and her former husband's daughter may, and unrelated women may.

cards.title: After zina
cards.ar: ومن زنى بامرأة حرمت عليه أمها وابنتها
cards.en: If a man commits zina (unlawful relations) with a woman, her mother and her daughter become forbidden for him to marry.

cards.title: Her sister during the iddah
cards.ar: امرأته طلاقا بائنا لم يجز له أن يتزوج بأختها حتى تنقضي عدتها
cards.en: If a man gives his wife a ba'in divorce (a final divorce that ends the marriage at once), he may not marry her sister until her iddah ends. The iddah is the waiting period a woman keeps after a divorce.

cards.ask: Tariq gave his wife a ba'in divorce. Her iddah has one month left. May he marry her sister now?
options: No: not until the iddah ends
Yes: a ba'in divorce ends the marriage at once
Yes, if his former wife agrees
cards.source: لم يجز له أن يتزوج بأختها حتى تنقضي عدتها
cards.why: He must wait until his former wife's iddah is over before marrying her sister.

cards.title: Owner and slave
cards.ar: ولا يجوز أن يتزوج المولى أمته ولا المرأة عبدها
cards.en: In al-Quduri's time some people were enslaved. An owner (mawla) may not marry his own slave woman (ama), and a woman may not marry her own slave ('abd).

cards.ask: Which of these may a man do?
options: Marry a woman and her former husband's daughter together
Marry a woman and her niece together
Marry his ex-wife's sister during her iddah
source: ولا بأس أن يجمع بين امرأة وابنة زوج كان لها من قبل
ولا ابنة أخيها ولا ابنة أختها
حتى تنقضي عدتها
cards.why: Only the woman and her former husband's daughter may be combined. Aunt and niece may not, and the sister must wait for the iddah to end.

lessons.title: People of the Book, ihram, two in one contract

cards.title: Women of the Book
cards.ar: ويجوز تزوج الكتابيات ولا يجوز تزوج المجوسيات ولا الوثنيات
cards.en: A Muslim man may marry a kitabiyya: a Jewish or Christian woman, from the People of the Book. He may not marry a Majusi woman (a fire-worshipper) or an idol-worshipper.

cards.title: The Sabians
cards.ar: ويجوز تزوج الصابئيات إذا كانوا يؤمنون بنبي ويقرون بكتاب وإن كانوا يعبدون الكواكب ولا كتاب لهم لم تجز مناكحتهم
cards.en: He may marry a Sabian woman if her people believe in a prophet and accept a revealed book. If they worship the stars and have no book, marrying them is not allowed.

cards.ask: Adam, a Muslim, wants to marry Sarah, a Christian woman. Is this allowed?
options: No: she must become Muslim first
Only if she is a Sabian
cards.source: ويجوز تزوج الكتابيات
cards.why: A Christian woman is from the People of the Book, so he may marry her.

cards.ask: May a Muslim man marry her?
items: A Sabian who believes in a prophet and a book
source: ويجوز تزوج الكتابيات ولا يجوز تزوج المجوسيات ولا الوثنيات
وإن كانوا يعبدون الكواكب ولا كتاب لهم لم تجز مناكحتهم
cards.why: Women of the Book and Sabians with a prophet and book are allowed. Majusi, idol-worshipping and bookless star-worshipping women are not.

cards.title: Nikah in ihram
cards.ar: ويجوز للمحرم والمحرمة أن يتزوجا في حال الإحرام
cards.en: Ihram is the sacred state a pilgrim enters for Hajj or Umrah. A man or woman in ihram may still marry.

cards.ask: Bilal and Zaynab are both in ihram for Umrah. Their families want to hold the nikah in Makkah before they finish. May they?
options: Yes: a nikah in ihram is allowed
No: they must leave ihram first
Only the woman may be in ihram
cards.source: ويجوز للمحرم والمحرمة أن يتزوجا في حال الإحرام
cards.why: Al-Quduri allows both the man and the woman in ihram to marry.

cards.title: Two women in one contract
cards.ar: ومن تزوج امرأتين في عقد واحد إحداهما لا يحل له نكاحها صح نكاح التي يحل له نكاحها وبطل نكاح الأخرى
cards.en: If a man marries two women in one contract and one of them is not allowed for him, the nikah with the allowed woman stands and the other is void.

cards.ask: In one contract, Yahya marries Asma, a Muslim, and Roxana, a Majusi woman. What happens?
options: Asma's nikah stands; Roxana's is void
source: صح نكاح التي يحل له نكاحها وبطل نكاح الأخرى
ولا يجوز تزوج المجوسيات
cards.why: A Majusi woman is not allowed for him, so only her nikah is void. Asma's stands.

cards.ask: Which word completes it?
cards.ar: ويجوز تزوج ____ ولا يجوز تزوج المجوسيات
cards.source: ويجوز تزوج الكتابيات ولا يجوز تزوج المجوسيات
cards.why: الكتابيات: women of the Book may be married; Majusi women may not.

cards.title: An adult woman's consent
cards.ar: وينعقد نكاح المرأة الحرة البالغة العاقلة برضاها وإن لم يعقد عليها ولي عند أبي حنيفة بكر كانت أو ثيبا وقال أبو يوسف ومحمد: لا ينعقد إلا بولي
cards.en: A free, adult, sane woman's nikah is made by her own consent, for Abu Hanifa, even if no wali (guardian) contracts it for her. This is so whether she is a bikr (never married before) or a thayyib (married before). Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad say it needs a wali.

cards.title: No forcing, and silence as a yes
cards.ar: ولا يجوز للولي إجبار البكر البالغة على النكاح وإذا استأذنها فسكتت أو ضحكت أو بكت فذلك إذن منها وإن أبت لم يزوجها
cards.en: A wali may not force an adult bikr to marry. If he asks her permission and she stays silent, laughs or cries, that is her permission. If she refuses, he may not marry her off.

cards.ask: Aisha, an adult bikr, is told by her father about a proposal from Hamza and asked if she agrees. She stays quiet. What does her silence mean?
options: He must ask her again until she speaks
cards.source: وإذا استأذنها فسكتت أو ضحكت أو بكت فذلك إذن منها
cards.why: For a bikr, silence, laughing or crying when asked counts as permission.

cards.ask: Fatima, an adult bikr, clearly says no to a proposal. Her father still wants it. May he marry her off?
options: No: if she refuses, he may not
Yes: a father can decide for a bikr
Yes, if the man is a good match
source: ولا يجوز للولي إجبار البكر البالغة على النكاح
وإن أبت لم يزوجها
cards.why: A wali cannot force an adult bikr. Her refusal stops the nikah.

cards.title: A thayyib must say it
cards.ar: وإذا استأذن الثيب فلا بد من رضاها بالقول
cards.en: When a thayyib (a woman married before) is asked, her consent must be spoken in words.

cards.ask: How does a thayyib consent? Complete it.
cards.ar: وإذا استأذن الثيب فلا بد من رضاها ____
cards.source: وإذا استأذن الثيب فلا بد من رضاها بالقول
cards.why: بالقول: in words. Silence is enough only for a bikr.

cards.ask: Khadija, a widow, is asked by her brother about a proposal. She only smiles. Has she consented?
options: No: a thayyib must agree in words
Yes, because she did not refuse
cards.source: فلا بد من رضاها بالقول
cards.why: Smiling is permission only from a bikr. A widow is a thayyib, so she must say it.

cards.title: Still counted a bikr
cards.ar: وإذا زالت بكارتها بوثبة أو حيضة أو جراح فهي في حكم الأبكار
cards.en: If a girl loses the physical sign of being a bikr through a jump, a heavy period or an injury, she is still treated as a bikr.

cards.title: If they disagree about her answer
cards.ar: وإذا قال الزوج: بلغك النكاح فسكت وقال: بل رددت فالقول قولها ولا يمين عليها ولا يستحلف في النكاح عند أبي حنيفة وقال أبو يوسف ومحمد: يستحلف فيه
cards.en: If the husband says "You heard of the nikah and stayed silent" and she says "No, I refused", her word is accepted and she does not have to swear an oath. For Abu Hanifa no oath is asked for in nikah. Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad say an oath may be asked for.

cards.ask: Ahmad says Sumayya stayed silent when told of the nikah. Sumayya says she refused at once. Whose word is accepted?
options: Ahmad's, if he swears an oath
cards.source: فالقول قولها ولا يمين عليها
cards.why: The word is hers, and she does not have to swear.

cards.ask: Does this count as her yes?
source: فسكتت أو ضحكت أو بكت فذلك إذن منها وإن أبت لم يزوجها
فلا بد من رضاها بالقول
cards.why: For a bikr, silence, laughing or crying is a yes, and a refusal is a no. A thayyib must say it in words.

cards.ask: Which of these is true in al-Quduri's text?
options: A wali may not force an adult bikr to marry
A thayyib's silence is her consent
A woman who refuses must swear an oath
source: ولا يجوز للولي إجبار البكر البالغة على النكاح
فلا بد من رضاها بالقول
فالقول قولها ولا يمين عليها
cards.why: The wali cannot force an adult bikr. A thayyib must speak, and the woman who says she refused swears no oath.

cards.title: A child's nikah and the wali
cards.ar: ويجوز نكاح الصغير إذا زوجهما الولي بكرا كانت الصغيرة أو ثيبا والولي هو العصبة
cards.en: A wali may contract the nikah of a young boy or girl. The wali is the 'asaba: the male relatives on the father's side, such as the father, grandfather, brother and uncle.

cards.title: A choice on coming of age
cards.ar: فإن زوجهما الأب أو الجد فلا خيار لهما بعد بلوغهما وإن زوجهما غير الأب والجد فلكل واحد منهما الخيار إذا بلغ إن شاء أقام على النكاح وإن شاء فسخ
cards.en: If the father or grandfather arranged it, the two have no choice once they come of age. If anyone else arranged it, each of them has a choice on coming of age: to stay in the nikah or to end it.

cards.ask: When Hind was young, her uncle arranged her nikah. She has now come of age. What may she do?
options: Choose to stay in the nikah or end it
Only her father may now decide
cards.source: وإن زوجهما غير الأب والجد فلكل واحد منهما الخيار إذا بلغ
cards.why: An uncle is not the father or grandfather, so Hind has the choice on coming of age.

cards.title: Who cannot be a wali
cards.ar: ولا ولاية لعبد ولا صغير ولا مجنون ولا كافر على مسلمة وقال أبو حنيفة: يجوز لغير العصبات من الأقارب التزويج
cards.en: A slave, a child, an insane person, or a non-Muslim over a Muslim woman cannot be a wali. Abu Hanifa said that relatives who are not 'asaba may also arrange a nikah.

cards.ask: Who cannot be the wali of a Muslim woman?
cards.source: ولا ولاية لعبد ولا صغير ولا مجنون ولا كافر على مسلمة
cards.why: A slave, a child, an insane person and a non-Muslim have no guardianship over a Muslim woman. Her adult Muslim brother is 'asaba.

cards.title: When the nearer wali is far away
cards.ar: ومن لا ولي لها إذا زوجها مولاها الذي أعتقها جاز وإذا غاب الولي الأقرب غيبة جاز لمن هو أبعد منه أن يزوج والغيبة المنقطعة: أن يكون في بلد لا تصل إليه القوافل في السنة إلا مرة واحدة
cards.en: A woman with no wali may be married off by the one who freed her. If the nearer wali is far away, the next wali may arrange the nikah. "Far away" means in a land the caravans reach only once a year.

cards.ask: What is "far away"? Complete it.
cards.ar: أن يكون في بلد لا تصل إليه ____ في السنة إلا مرة واحدة
cards.source: أن يكون في بلد لا تصل إليه القوافل في السنة إلا مرة واحدة
cards.why: القوافل: a land the caravans reach only once a year.

cards.ask: Maryam's father lives in a far land that caravans reach only once a year. Her brother is at home. Who may arrange her nikah?
options: Her brother, as the next wali
No one until her father returns
source: وإذا غاب الولي الأقرب غيبة جاز لمن هو أبعد منه أن يزوج
لا تصل إليه القوافل في السنة إلا مرة واحدة
cards.why: The nearer wali is far away by the book's measure, so the next wali, her brother, may arrange it.

cards.title: An insane woman's father and son
cards.ar: وإذا اجمع في المجنونة أبوها وابنها فالولي في نكاحها ابنها عند أبي حنيفة وأبي يوسف وقال محمد: أبوها
cards.en: If an insane woman has both a father and a son, her wali for nikah is her son, for Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf. Note: Muhammad says her father.

cards.title: A wali marrying her himself
cards.ar: ويجوز لابن العم أن يزوج بنت عمه من نفسه وإذا أذنت المرأة لرجل أن يزوجها من نفسه فقعد بحضرة شاهدين جاز
cards.en: A cousin who is her wali may marry his uncle's daughter to himself. And if a woman permits a man to marry her to himself, and he makes the contract before two witnesses, it is valid.

cards.ask: Salma's wali is her cousin Idris, and they wish to marry. With her consent, Idris makes the nikah himself before two witnesses. Is it valid?
options: Yes: a cousin may marry her to himself
No: someone else must be her wali
No: a wali can never marry his ward
cards.source: ويجوز لابن العم أن يزوج بنت عمه من نفسه
cards.why: The book allows the cousin to marry his uncle's daughter to himself, before two witnesses.

cards.ask: Bashir's father arranged his nikah when Bashir was young. Now he is an adult. Does he have a choice to end it?
options: Yes: every child has the choice
Yes, if he asks within a year
cards.source: فإن زوجهما الأب أو الجد فلا خيار لهما بعد بلوغهما
cards.why: When the father or grandfather arranged it, there is no choice on coming of age.

cards.title: Kafa'a matters
cards.ar: والكفاءة في النكاح معتبرة فإذا تزوجت المرأة غير كفء فللأولياء أن يفرقوا بينهما
cards.en: Kafa'a means the husband being a suitable match (kufu) for the wife. It is taken into account: if a woman marries a man who is not her match, her walis may have them separated.

cards.title: In what kafa'a is measured
cards.ar: والكفاءة تعتبر في النسب والدين والمال وهو: أن يكون مالكا للمهر والنفقة وتعتبر في الصنائع
cards.en: Kafa'a looks at lineage, religion, wealth and trade. Wealth here means he can pay the mahr and the nafaqa. The mahr is the gift a husband must give his wife for the nikah; the nafaqa is her upkeep: food, clothing and home.

cards.ask: Complete it.
cards.ar: والكفاءة تعتبر في ____
cards.source: والكفاءة تعتبر في النسب
cards.why: النسب: lineage is the first thing al-Quduri names.

cards.ask: Which of these does kafa'a look at?

options.text: Being able to pay the mahr and upkeep

source: والكفاءة تعتبر في النسب والدين والمال
أن يكون مالكا للمهر والنفقة وتعتبر في الصنائع
cards.why: Lineage, religion, wealth (mahr and nafaqa) and trade. Height and city are not named.

cards.ask: Zayd proposes to Ruqayya, but he has no means to pay a mahr or provide her upkeep. In wealth, is he a kufu for her?
options: No: wealth means owning the mahr and the upkeep
Yes: wealth does not matter in kafa'a
Yes, if he has a trade
cards.source: والمال وهو: أن يكون مالكا للمهر والنفقة
cards.why: Al-Quduri defines wealth in kafa'a as owning enough for the mahr and nafaqa.

cards.ask: An adult woman marries a man who is not a kufu for her. What may her walis do?
options: Cancel it only if she was a bikr
cards.source: فإذا تزوجت المرأة غير كفء فللأولياء أن يفرقوا بينهما
cards.why: The walis may have them separated when the husband is not her match.

cards.title: A mahr below her worth
cards.ar: وإذا تزوجت المرأة ونقصت من مهرها فللأولياء الاعتراض عليها عند أبي حنيفة حتى يتم لها مهر مثلها أو يفارقها
cards.en: If a woman marries for less than her proper mahr, her walis may object, for Abu Hanifa, until the husband completes her mahr al-mithl or parts from her. Mahr al-mithl is the usual mahr of women like her in her family.

cards.ask: Asma marries for a mahr far below what the women of her family receive. Her walis object. What ends their objection?
options: The husband completes her mahr al-mithl, or they part
cards.source: حتى يتم لها مهر مثلها أو يفارقها
cards.why: The walis may object until he completes her mahr al-mithl or parts from her.

cards.title: Only a father or grandfather
cards.ar: ونقص من مهرها أو ابنه الصغير وزاد في مهر جاز ذلك عليهما ولا يجوز ذلك لغير الأب والجد
cards.en: If a father marries off his young daughter for less than her proper mahr, or his young son for more, it holds against them. No one but the father or grandfather may do this.

cards.ask: An uncle arranges his young niece's nikah for a mahr well below her mahr al-mithl. Does the lower mahr hold?
options: No: only a father or grandfather may do this
Yes: any wali may do this
Yes, if two witnesses are present
cards.source: ولا يجوز ذلك لغير الأب والجد
cards.why: Only the father or grandfather may lower a young daughter's mahr.

cards.ask: Which of these is NOT one of the things kafa'a looks at?
cards.source: والكفاءة تعتبر في النسب والدين والمال
cards.why: Lineage, religion, wealth and trade are named. Beauty is not part of kafa'a.

cards.title: Named or not
cards.ar: ويصح النكاح إذا سمى فيه مهرا ويصح وإن لم يسم فيه مهرا
cards.en: The nikah is valid whether or not a mahr is named in it. The mahr is the gift the husband must give his wife.

cards.title: The least mahr
cards.ar: وأقل المهر عشرة دراهم فإن سمى أقل من عشرة فلها العشرة
cards.en: The least mahr is ten dirhams (silver coins). If less than ten is named, she gets ten.

cards.ask: Complete it.
cards.ar: وأقل المهر ____ دراهم
cards.source: وأقل المهر عشرة دراهم
cards.why: عشرة: the least mahr is ten dirhams.

cards.ask: Hamid names a mahr of 6 dirhams for Zaynab. What is she owed?
cards.source: فإن سمى أقل من عشرة فلها العشرة
cards.why: Below ten, she is owed the ten.

cards.title: Full or half
cards.ar: ومن سمى مهرا عشرة فما زاد فعليه المسمى إن دخل بها أو مات عنها وإن طلقها قبل الدخول والخلوة فلها نصف المسمى
cards.en: If he named ten or more, he owes all of it once the marriage is consummated (dukhul) or if he dies. If he divorces her before dukhul and before khalwa (being alone together in private), she gets half of what was named.

cards.ask: Yasin named a mahr of 1,000 dirhams, then divorced Huda before they had ever been alone together. What does she get?
cards.source: وإن طلقها قبل الدخول والخلوة فلها نصف المسمى
cards.why: Divorce before dukhul and khalwa gives her half the named mahr: 500.

cards.title: When no mahr was named
cards.ar: وإن تزوجها ولم يسم لها مهرا أو تزوجها على أن لا مهر لها فلها مهر مثلها إن دخل بها أو مات عنها وإن طلقها قبل الدخول فلها المتعة وهي ثلاثة أثواب من كسوة مثلها
cards.en: If no mahr was named, or they even agreed there would be none, she gets her mahr al-mithl (the usual mahr of women like her) after dukhul or if he dies. If he divorces her before dukhul she gets the mut'a: a parting gift of three garments, the kind of clothes a woman like her wears.

cards.ask: Ibrahim married Sumayya without naming a mahr, then divorced her before dukhul. What is she owed?
cards.source: وإن طلقها قبل الدخول فلها المتعة وهي ثلاثة أثواب من كسوة مثلها
cards.why: With no mahr named and a divorce before dukhul, she is owed the mut'a of three garments.

cards.title: A forbidden thing as mahr
cards.ar: وإن تزوج المسلم على خمر أو خنزير فالنكاح جائز ولها مهر مثلها
cards.en: If a Muslim names wine or pork as the mahr, the nikah is still valid and she gets her mahr al-mithl.

cards.title: A mahr agreed after the nikah
cards.ar: ثم تراضيا على تسمية مهر فهو لها إن دخل بها أو مات عنها وإن طلقها قبل الدخول لها المتعة
cards.en: If no mahr was named and they later agree on one, it is hers after dukhul or if he dies. If he divorces her before dukhul, she gets the mut'a.

cards.ask: What is she owed?
items: 1,000 named, divorced before dukhul and khalwa
Wine named as mahr, after dukhul
source: فعليه المسمى إن دخل بها أو مات عنها وإن طلقها قبل الدخول والخلوة فلها نصف المسمى
فلها مهر مثلها إن دخل بها أو مات عنها
فالنكاح جائز ولها مهر مثلها
cards.why: A named mahr is owed in full after dukhul or death, half if divorced before. With none named, or a forbidden one, she gets mahr al-mithl.

cards.ask: A mahr of 4 dirhams is named, and the husband divorces before dukhul and khalwa. What is she owed?
source: فإن سمى أقل من عشرة فلها العشرة
فلها نصف المسمى
cards.why: Less than ten counts as ten, and divorce before dukhul gives half: 5 dirhams.

cards.title: Adding to or lowering the mahr
cards.ar: وإن زادها في المهر بعد العقد لزمته الزيادة وتسقط بالطلاق قبل الدخول وإن حطت عنه من مهرها صح الحط
cards.en: If the husband adds to the mahr after the contract, he owes the extra, but it falls away if he divorces her before dukhul. If the wife lets him off part of her mahr, that is valid.

cards.ask: Musa named 1,000 dirhams, later added 200 as a kindness, then divorced his wife before dukhul. What does she get?
source: لزمته الزيادة وتسقط بالطلاق قبل الدخول
فلها نصف المسمى
cards.why: The added 200 drops with divorce before dukhul, so she gets half of 1,000.

cards.ask: Layla's mahr is 2,000 dirhams. She tells her husband she lets him off 500 of it. Does this count?
options: Yes: her lowering it is valid
No: the mahr can never be lowered
cards.source: وإن حطت عنه من مهرها صح الحط
cards.why: A wife may let her husband off part of her mahr, and it holds.

cards.title: A valid khalwa
cards.ar: وإذا خلا الزوج بامرأته
cards.en: Khalwa is husband and wife being alone together in private. If they were alone with nothing preventing them from being together as a married couple, and then he divorces her, she gets the full mahr.

cards.title: When khalwa does not count
cards.ar: وإن كان أحدهما مريضا أو صائما في رمضان أو محرما بفرض أو نفل بحج أو عمرة أو كانت حائضا فليست بخلوة صحيحة
cards.en: It is not a valid khalwa if one of them is ill, fasting in Ramadan, in ihram for a fard or voluntary Hajj or Umrah, or if she is in her monthly period (hayd).

cards.ask: Which of these stop a khalwa from counting?

options.text: One of them is fasting in Ramadan
One of them is in ihram for Umrah
She is in her monthly period

cards.source: وإن كان أحدهما مريضا أو صائما في رمضان أو محرما بفرض أو نفل بحج أو عمرة أو كانت حائضا فليست بخلوة صحيحة
cards.why: Illness, the Ramadan fast, ihram and her period each stop it being a valid khalwa. The time of day is not named.

cards.ask: Anas and his wife were alone at home, both well and with nothing in the way. Later he divorced her before dukhul. The mahr named was 800. What does she get?
cards.source: مانع من الوطء ثم طلقها فلها كمال المهر
cards.why: A valid khalwa followed by divorce gives her the full mahr.

cards.ask: Hasan and his wife were alone during a Ramadan day while he was fasting. Later he divorced her before dukhul. Was that a valid khalwa?
options: No: fasting in Ramadan stops it
Yes, if it was after Asr
cards.source: أو صائما في رمضان
cards.why: Being in the Ramadan fast is one of the things that make it not a valid khalwa.

cards.title: A husband unable to be with her
cards.ar: وإذا خلا المجبوب بامرأته ثم طلقها فلها كمال المهر عند أبي حنيفة
cards.en: If a husband who is physically unable to be with his wife (majbub) is alone with her and then divorces her, she gets the full mahr, for Abu Hanifa.

cards.title: The parting gift is recommended
cards.ar: وتستحب المتعة لكل مطلقة إلا لمطلقة واحدة وهي: التي طلقها قبل الدخول ولم يسم لها مهرا
cards.en: The mut'a (parting gift) is recommended (mustahabb) for every divorced woman except one: the one divorced before dukhul with no mahr named. For her, as the last lesson taught, the mut'a is what she is owed.

cards.ask: Nusayba was divorced after years of marriage and was paid her full mahr. Is giving her a parting gift recommended?
options: Yes: it is recommended for every divorced woman but one
No: she already has her mahr
It is owed to her as a debt
cards.source: وتستحب المتعة لكل مطلقة
cards.why: Only the woman divorced before dukhul with no mahr named is left out; for Nusayba it is recommended.

cards.ask: Which statement matches al-Quduri?
options: A wife may lower her own mahr
An added mahr stays even after divorce before dukhul
A khalwa while she is in her period is valid
source: وإن حطت عنه من مهرها صح الحط
وتسقط بالطلاق قبل الدخول
أو كانت حائضا فليست بخلوة صحيحة
cards.why: Her lowering is valid. The added part falls away, and a khalwa in her period is not valid.

lessons.title: Unusual mahrs and conditions
lessons.arabic: وإذا تزوجها على حيوان غير موصوف

cards.title: One nikah as the mahr of the other
cards.ar: على أن يزوجه الرجل أخته أو ابنته ليكون أحد العقدين عوضا عن الآخر فالعقدان جائزان ولكل واحدة منهما مهر مثلها
cards.en: If one man marries his daughter to another on condition that the other marries him his sister or daughter, so that each nikah is the price of the other, both contracts are valid and each woman gets her mahr al-mithl.

cards.ask: Two fathers agree: each one's daughter marries the other's son, and each nikah is the mahr for the other. What happens?
options: Both nikahs are valid, and each bride gets her mahr al-mithl
Valid, with no mahr for either
cards.source: فالعقدان جائزان ولكل واحدة منهما مهر مثلها
cards.why: Both contracts stand, and each woman is owed her mahr al-mithl.

cards.title: Service or teaching as a mahr
cards.ar: وإن تزوج حر امرأة على خدمته سنة أو على تعليم القرآن فلها مهر مثلها وإن تزوج عبد حرة بإذن مولاه على خدمتها سنة جاز
cards.en: If a free man names as the mahr a year of his service, or teaching her the Qur'an, she gets her mahr al-mithl instead. But if a slave marries a free woman, with his owner's permission, for a year of service to her, that is valid.

cards.ask: Idris, a free man, offers as his mahr to teach Amira the Qur'an. What is she owed?
cards.source: أو على تعليم القرآن فلها مهر مثلها
cards.why: Teaching the Qur'an does not stand as his mahr; she gets her mahr al-mithl.

cards.title: A mahr with a condition
cards.ar: وإذا تزوج امرأة على ألف درهم على أن لا يخرجها من البلد أو على أن لا يتزوج عليها فإن وفى بالشرط فلها المسمى وإن تزوج عليها أو أخرجها من البلد فلها مهر مثلها
cards.en: If he marries her for 1,000 dirhams on condition that he won't take her out of her town, or won't marry another wife, then if he keeps the condition she gets the 1,000. If he marries another or takes her away, she gets her mahr al-mithl.

cards.ask: Rashid married Hana for 1,000 dirhams on condition he would not move her from her town. Later he moved her to another city. What is she owed?
cards.source: وإن تزوج عليها أو أخرجها من البلد فلها مهر مثلها
cards.why: He broke the condition, so she gets her mahr al-mithl instead of the named sum.

cards.title: An animal not described
cards.ar: وإذا تزوجها على حيوان غير موصوف صحت التسمية ولها الوسط منه والزوج مخير: إن شاء أعطاها ذلك وإن شاء أعطاها قيمته
cards.en: If the mahr is an animal that is not described (say, "a horse"), the naming is valid and she gets one of middle quality. The husband may choose to give her the animal or its value.

cards.ask: Which one does she get? Complete it.
cards.ar: صحت التسمية ولها ____ منه
cards.source: صحت التسمية ولها الوسط منه
cards.why: الوسط: one of middle quality.

cards.title: A cloth not described
cards.ar: ولو تزوجها على ثوب غير موصوف فلها مهر مثلها
cards.en: But if the mahr is a cloth that is not described, she gets her mahr al-mithl.

cards.ask: Does the named mahr stand?
items: A free man's year of service
source: صحت التسمية ولها الوسط منه
فإن وفى بالشرط فلها المسمى
ولو تزوجها على ثوب غير موصوف فلها مهر مثلها
على خدمته سنة أو على تعليم القرآن فلها مهر مثلها
cards.why: An undescribed animal and a kept condition stand. An undescribed cloth, a free man's service and Qur'an teaching give her mahr al-mithl.

cards.ask: Uthman names "a camel" as the mahr, without describing it. What may he give?
options: A camel of middle quality, or its value
cards.source: ولها الوسط منه والزوج مخير: إن شاء أعطاها ذلك وإن شاء أعطاها قيمته
cards.why: The naming is valid: she gets a middle one, and he chooses between the animal and its value.

cards.title: An enslaved person's nikah
cards.ar: ولا يجوز نكاح العبد والأمة إلا بإذن مولاهما وإذا تزوج العبد بإذن مولاه فالمهر دين في رقبته يباع فيه
cards.en: An enslaved man ('abd) or woman (ama) may marry only with the owner's (mawla's) permission. If the man marries with permission, the mahr is a debt on him, and he may be sold to pay it.

cards.title: An ama's home
cards.ar: وإذا زوج المولى أمته فليس عليه أن يبوئها بيت الزوج ولكنها تخدم المولى ويقال للزوج: متى ظفرت بها وطئتها
cards.en: If an owner marries off his ama, he does not have to give her a home with her husband. She keeps serving the owner, and the husband is told he may be with her whenever he can.

cards.title: Mut'a and fixed-term marriage are void
cards.ar: ونكاح المتعة والنكاح المؤقت باطل
cards.en: Nikah al-mut'a (a "marriage" for enjoyment for a set time) and a nikah for a fixed period are void (batil): they are not a marriage at all.

cards.ask: A man offers a woman a nikah "for one month only". What is it?
options: Void: a fixed-term nikah is batil
Valid, but becomes a normal nikah
cards.source: ونكاح المتعة والنكاح المؤقت باطل
cards.why: A nikah limited to a time is void.

cards.title: Pending until approved
cards.ar: وتزويج العبد والأمة بغير إذن مولاهما موقوف: فإن أجازه المولى جاز وإن رده بطل وكذلك لو زوج امرأة بغير رضاها أو رجلا بغير رضاه
cards.en: A nikah of an enslaved person without the owner's permission is mawquf: on hold. If the owner approves it, it is valid; if he rejects it, it is void. The same is true when someone marries off a woman or a man without their consent.

cards.ask: Hamza is an adult. His uncle arranges a nikah for him without asking him. When Hamza hears, he gladly approves. What is the nikah?
options: Valid: it was pending and he approved it
Valid only if his father approves
cards.source: وكذلك لو زوج امرأة بغير رضاها أو رجلا بغير رضاه
cards.why: A nikah made without his consent waits on him. His approval makes it valid.

cards.title: A choice when she is freed
cards.ar: وإذا زوج الأمة مولاها ثم أعتقت فلها الخيار حرا كان زوجها أو عبدا وكذلك المكاتبة
cards.en: If an ama's owner married her off and she is later freed, she has a choice to stay or leave, whether her husband is free or enslaved. The same holds for a mukataba (a woman buying her freedom by installments).
